note: Offline anchors for every dependency that cannot be pulled from a plain npm registry. restore.ps1 rewrites the matching entries in profiles/desktop/package.json to these file: paths.

anchors.why: contract layer; pinned to a local file: so the community going dark cannot break the runtime
upstream is a git+https dependency; without a vendored copy a clean restore needs GitHub reachability, which this machine does not reliably have
